title: ELIZA: findingeliza.org and the ELIZA Research Bench
description: The website of the ELIZA Archaeology Project (findingeliza.org) and the ELIZA Research Bench, which reads Joseph Weizenbaum's ELIZA (MIT, 1964–68) in its surviving versions: the 1965 MAD-SLIP source, its SLIP library, the DOCTOR scripts of 1965 and 1966, and the conversations printed from them. It includes a JavaScript ELIZA running the 1966 DOCTOR script and the Implementations catalogue of later ELIZAs.
